newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shark attack victim in critical condition.
newsitem.headline: NZ shark attack victim in critical condition.

text.p: A 23-year-old man was in critical condition in hospital on Friday after being badly mauled by a shark whilst diving from a boat off New Zealand's Chatham Islands.
Vaughan Hill was in intensive care after being flown about 750 km (470 miles) to Wellington Hospital, a spokeswoman for the hospital said.
Hill was attacked while diving on Friday morning off Pitt Island, part of the Chathams group east of New Zealand's South Island, said Air Chathams radio telephonist Bernice Lanauze.
"Reports are that he was very badly mutilated," Lanauze told Reuters. She said people on a nearby boat saw the attack and rescued Hill.
Lanauze said a doctor took about an hour to stabilise Hill's condition and he was then flown via Chatham Island to Wellington with his wife, family members and a medical team.
